Champions Team Story: Saeed studies in the third grade and he is a diligent and polite student. Khalid and Tariq are Saeed's friends, and he loves them a lot and they love him, and they all play with the school soccer team. One day, Saeed suggested that his team play against the other neighboring school's team. The friends were happy with this suggestion and said: But who will coordinate with the other team? Saeed said: I will coordinate with them, and you, Khalid, help me with this task. The friends said: And we are ready and happy for this match with the other school. The two teams agreed on the date of the match, and the match began, and they were all in enthusiasm with high sportsmanship. Saeed's team won against the other team, Saeed went to his home and said to his mother: Mother, I won today in the match and you are the reason for my winning and success; because you were encouraging and supportive to me, for the mother is the secret of her children's success. Then he looked at his two sisters Sarah and Ghada and said to them: And you two also were the ones helping me in arranging my sports clothes and reminding me of the sports training times and preserving my supplies, so thank you all. And Saeed and his family held a celebration for this victory.

Noun Definition Text: It is every word used to name a human, animal, inanimate object, or anything else, and time is not part of it.
Verb Definition Text: The verb is what indicates an action combined with time: Past, Present, or Imperative.
Particle Definition Text: The particle is a word that does not give meaning by itself, but acquires its meaning when joined to nouns and verbs.
Nominal Sentence Intro Title: In the previous text, sentences are as follows:
Intro Sent 2: The white rose is a symbol of purity.
Intro Sent 3: The violet is a sad flower.
Nominal Definition Title: These are sentences starting with a noun, so they are known as Nominal Sentences.
Nominal Definition Text: The word (Al-Wurood) is a noun with which the speech began or the sentence began; therefore, it is called (Mubtada'), and the Mubtada' is always in the nominative case (Marfu'), then the rest of the sentence is the Khabar.
Parsing Definition Footer: Stating the vowel of the end of the word is called Parsing (I'rab).
Diagram Mubtada Text: A nominative noun at the beginning of the sentence
Diagram Khabar Text: The rest of the sentence that completes the meaning

Parse Anwa: Khabar Marfu' (Nominative) and its sign of raising is the Damma.
Parse Banafsaj: Mubtada' Marfu' (Nominative) and its sign of raising is the Damma.

Noun Benefit Subtitle: How do I know a Noun?
Noun Sign 1: 1- The word indicating a noun may start with *(Al)* *(The Moon - The Sun)*
Noun Sign 2: 2- The word indicating a noun may be preceded by a preposition *(From the house to the club)*
Noun Sign 3: 3- The word indicating a noun may end with Tanween *(I saw a moon)*
Noun Sign 4: 4- The word indicating a noun accepts addition (Addition is defining an indefinite noun by a definite noun like: *(Football - Star Club - Flag of the Country - Space Ship) (I greeted the school principal)*)
Noun Benefit Footer: One or more signs may combine in a word indicating it is a noun.
Noun Division Title: Divisions of the Noun Based on Number
Noun Division Subtitle: In Arabic Language, nouns are divided by number into:
Noun Type Singular Definition: Indicates one: male or female *(Happy (M) - Happy (F))*.
Noun Type Dual Definition: Indicates two: male or female *(Two pens - Two apples)*.
Noun Type Plural Definition: Indicates three or more: male or female *(Men - Women) (Teachers (M) - Teachers (F))*.
